classification.difficultyReason: Interpret equal sharing as three divided by four and express each share relative to one bar; the supplied subdivisions support distributing quarters.

content.prompt: Share these 3 chocolate bars equally among 4 friends. What fraction of a whole chocolate bar will each person get?

spec.sourceRegion: Exercise 4C, question 10: horizontal row of three chocolate bars
spec.description: Three equally sized rectangular bars arranged horizontally. Each bar has two rows and four columns. Uniform chocolate colouring is omitted under the house outline convention.
spec.mathematics: Three whole bars, each partitioned into eight equal pieces.
spec.answerVisibility: All three complete bars and their partitions are permanent givens; no allocation to friends is shown.

answer.worked:
Give each friend one quarter of each of the three bars. Each quarter contains two of the eight pieces, so each friend receives six pieces altogether.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Each person's share}&=3\div4\\\text{Each person's share}&=\frac{3}{4}\text{ of a whole chocolate bar.}\end{align*}$$
